component.name: Obscura VPN
component.summary: Privacy that’s more than a promise

description.p: Can’t log. Won’t lag. Works anywhere.
Obscura is the first VPN that can’t log your activity and keeps you connected wherever you go.

ul.li: Our Two-Party VPN design makes logging impossible even if we tried.
Our QUIC-powered protocol keeps you connected even on challenging networks.
Reliable connectivity: Obscura adapts to changing network conditions for uninterrupted access.
Two-party relay: by using a fully independent exit hop, Obscura is the first VPN that puts a firewall between who you are and what you do online.
Personal details not necessary: log in with a random account number; pay by card, Bitcoin Lightning, or Monero: your choice.
Lag-free speed: WireGuard® + QUIC tunnelling plus smart routing deliver smooth streaming, gaming, and calls.
Provably private: public source code (on GitHub) and matching WireGuard® keys ensure provable privacy.

description.p: Join the fight for an open, private internet - download Obscura and browse freely with privacy you can prove and performance you can feel.
